verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an OpenAPI spec file on the Cloudflare developer docs site (probe-3), an llms.txt, and code snippets in the docs. None of this documents an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-browser examples for AI Gateway. A raw OpenAPI JSON is a building block hosted at the Cloudflare platform level, not the interactive explorer itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
